snippet.title: SLAUGHTER VOID Next Fest Trailer
snippet.description:
SLAUGHTER VOID is a brutal, high intensity hack and slash, combining the best of speed running and 80's arcade action with fast-paced combat and build variety. Hotline Miami meets Diablo in this homage to the classic, blood spattered fantasy of the 70's and 80's. Check it out during Steam Next Fest on February 23rd!

Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3333980/Slaughter_Void/

Shout out to Enervate for the usage of No Way Out! Check them out here:
Instagram: https://instagram.com/enervatemke/?hl=en
Bandcamp: https://enervatehc.bandcamp.com/music
